file_purpose: Research and evidence profile for University of Sheffield MBChB Medicine A100. This file preserves the supplied official-source research, native-scale historical guidance, implementation mapping and known review boundaries; executable rules live in data/universities/sheffield-a100.json.

research_scope.evidence_intake_basis: ApplySmart_Sheffield_A100_Research2.md supplied by the user on 2026-07-06
research_scope.notes: Only native 2700-scale 2025-26 cutpoints are executable. Legacy 3600-scale figures are retained only as labelled context.

evidence_classification_policy.official: A rule or statistic attributed by the supplied research to a first-party University of Sheffield source.
evidence_classification_policy.foi_verified: A statistic contained in an attributable University of Sheffield FOI response archived publicly.
evidence_classification_policy.historical_guidance: A cycle-labelled observation used to position interview competitiveness, never as a current guarantee.
evidence_classification_policy.unverified_researcher_supplied: A value present in the research without an independently logged source reference; not used for production behaviour.
evidence_classification_policy.unknown: The supplied evidence does not establish the fact safely enough for execution.
evidence_classification_policy.intake_caveat: The user designated the completed Markdown research as authoritative. Source classifications preserve its evidence log and caveats.

route_limited_blockers: International A100 historical lowest, average and highest UCAT distributions beyond the partially evidenced cycles are incomplete, and the supplied 2021/2022 International rows still lack logged source references.
A101 historical UCAT and application/interview/offer distributions are not published in the supplied evidence; A101 is a separate course outside this A100 implementation.
Country-specific international qualification equivalences are not tabulated.
Post-interview tie-breakers and MMI plus SJT score distributions are not published; this evidence is outside the implemented A100 interview-prediction scope.
engine_execution_boundaries: Scottish Higher plus Advanced Higher eligibility is fully evidenced and mapped, but remains manual review because the generic interview classifier cannot faithfully evaluate the joint profile.

Graduate A100 eligibility is fully evidenced and mapped as a 2:1 degree plus BBB school-qualification branch, but remains manual review because the generic interview classifier does not combine both conditions.
GCSE and A-level resit rules are fully evidenced and mapped, but Sheffield's one-resit and same-sitting conditions remain manual review.
The EPQ route is fully evidenced and mapped, but the generic qualification evaluator does not read the EPQ alternative.
The contextual IB offer is fully evidenced and mapped, but remains manual review because the generic classifier cannot safely group-filter that route.
Environmental Science GCSE acceptance is fully evidenced and mapped, but remains manual review because Engine v1.0 has no canonical Environmental Science subject identifier.
The ordinary A-level two-year and same-first-sitting condition is fully evidenced but not automatically verified.
The IELTS 7.5 overall and 7.0 component rule is fully evidenced, but the shared classifier cannot represent the 7.5 overall threshold exactly.
readiness.summary: Official evidence supports scoped A100 eligibility and pool-specific UCAT interview guidance for Home, International and verified Access to Sheffield Medicine/pathway applicants.

course_identity.medical_school: School of Medicine and Population Health

steps: Require a current-cycle UCAT cognitive total of at least 1800/2700.
For ordinary applicants, rank by UCAT within the separate Home or International pool.
For verified Access to Sheffield Medicine/pathway applicants, bypass ordinary UCAT ranking after the academic and UCAT minimum gates.

gcse.minimum_profile: At least five GCSEs at grade 7/A, with English Language, Mathematics and at least one accepted science at grade 6/B.
gcse.resits: Accepted under one-resit and single-resit-sitting conditions.

a_level.contextual: AAB with A in Chemistry or Biology
a_level.subject_rule: Chemistry or Biology plus a second science from Biology/Human Biology, Chemistry, Mathematics, Physics or Psychology.
a_level.epq_alternative: AAB with A in Chemistry or Biology plus A in EPQ

international_baccalaureate.standard: 36 points with 6,6 in HL Chemistry or Biology plus a second science
international_baccalaureate.contextual: 34 points with the published HL and SL conditions

scottish.standard: AAABB Highers plus AA Advanced Highers in Chemistry or Biology and a second science
scottish.contextual: AABBB Highers plus AB Advanced Highers

graduate_a100.requirement: 2:1 degree plus BBB at A-level including Chemistry or Biology and a second science

english_language.ielts: 7.5 overall with at least 7.0 in each component
documented_exemptions: SQA Higher or Advanced Higher English B

scale_policy.reason: Removal of Abstract Reasoning was not a proportional rescale; approximate conversions cannot support pass/fail boundaries.

historical_context.warning: The 2025-26 values are historical guidance, not current or future cut-offs, probabilities or guarantees.

2021 and 2022 International UCAT and volume rows without logged FOI references

general_access_sheffield.academic_adjustment: AAB with A in Chemistry or Biology

interview_information.post_interview_scoring: Informational research only; no executable MMI or SJT scoring and no post-interview prediction.
